title: Red quartzite conduit and collection bowl at Abusir

tellings.quote: Below the eastern temple, there is a red quartzite conduit system. This red quartzite conduit goes underneath the black paving, black basalt paving of the eastern temple and it deposits into a red quartzite collection bowl.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who believes the pyramids had a practical purpose, says that below the eastern temple of the Pyramid of Niuserre at Abusir in Egypt there is 'a red quartzite conduit system' running under the black basalt paving into 'a red quartzite collection bowl.' He says he saw it himself in 2017 and credits a guide named Yousef Awyan, the same trip on which he describes an ammonia smell and staining inside another pyramid. To him it suggests the site once moved and collected some liquid as part of a working process.
